headline: Colombia GDP grows 0.5% in third quarter as high interest rates restrict growth
summary: Colombia's economy grew 0.5% in the third quarter, its weakest pace of the year, as high interest rates weighed on commerce, construction, and manufacturing, despite gains in mining and public services.
why: Subdued gross domestic product expansion influences Colombia's central bank decisions regarding future policy rate cuts and fiscal deficit targets.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Gross domestic product rose only 0.5% in Q3, representing the slowest expansion of the year.
